presentation.label: KLANG
presentation.summary: A swept-carrier ring modulator: sirens, dive bombs and clanging metal.
presentation.overview: A swept-carrier ring modulator: sirens, dive bombs and clanging metal.
highlights: Play a sustained tone and sweep the modulation to hear the metallic sidebands.
usage: Add Klang from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Play a sustained tone and sweep the modulation to hear the metallic sidebands.
Compare the effect with bypass using the footswitch.

access.location: Delay group in the MS-70CDR effect list, under Klang.
steps: Add Klang from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Play a sustained tone and sweep the modulation to hear the metallic sidebands.

controls.name: Freq
controls.doc: params[5]. Carrier centre frequency (~0.5..2000 Hz, linear). Range 0–100.

controls.name: Sweep
controls.doc: params[6]. Carrier LFO rate (0..~12 Hz) + depth together; 0 = static. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Mix
controls.doc: Mix default 1 (quiet-safe). The editor materialises patches on load (full-patch send), so audible-on-load no longer needs a hot default. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.

load.conditions: The effect descriptor declares this cost. Audio load on the pedal is unmeasured.

tests.summary: Ziddle passed the loader check and rendered 22,050 stereo frames. The compiled file passed the stock-code scan and MS-70CDR size limits. Hardware untested.
